gallery.title: File:10 - Cutters Landing apartments (4741178191).jpg
gallery.description: Cutters Landing is a unique residential precinct on more than 4 hectares of land, previously occupied by the Colonial Sugar Refinery. New apartments and houses are integrated with the site’s historic buildings and structures, including the refurbished 1893 refinery as loft-style apartments, the 1901 workers’ recreation room as a gym and the retention of remnant sections of the wharf and railway line as part of the public spaces.

gallery.filename: StateLibQld 1 171479 Brisbane River, between New Farm and Hawthorne, during the 1931 flood.jpg
gallery.title: File:StateLibQld 1 171479 Brisbane River, between New Farm and Hawthorne, during the 1931 flood.jpg
gallery.description:
Brisbane River, between New Farm and Hawthorne, during the 1931 flood.
People gathered at the water's edge at Hawthorne with a view across to CSR refinery at New Farm, during the 1931 Brisbane floods. People have come on foot carrying umbrellas, or on bicycles to view the damage caused by the floodwaters. A number of children have waded out into the water. It was probably at the site of the Blondells Engineering on Scott Street. Today, the Hawthorn location is next to the Hawthorn Ferry terminal and Hardcastle Park. (Description supplied with photograph).
categories: Images from the State Library of Queensland
